approach: The repository has no worktree-reading code today (no load_current, no records_reader_scan; I grepped both). Records::load and RecordSet::load read records/ from a git tree at HEAD; introspect::read_records and xtask walltime::read_jobs read <root>/records/ as files. Plan: (1) add a helper in athena-data paths.rs that names the worktree <state dir>/records-worktree, derives the state dir from `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`, and selects the worktree when it holds athena/records, else in-tree root. (2) Add Records::load_current and RecordSet::load_current (worktree tip when present, else the passed head) and switch every production caller meaning 'current' plus the two file readers. (3) Replace <root>/.git in backtest.rs and walltime.rs with git's common dir. (4) Add the xtask records_reader_scan test with a call-site allow-list. (5) Add records_branch_readers.rs with a worktree and a fallback test per reader. (6) Record decisions and changelog. site.rs untouched. Tests build their own repos and worktrees under a tempdir with ATHENA_STATE_DIR set to a tempdir.

decisions.choice: Gate the move on worktree presence: use <state>/records-worktree when it is a checkout of athena/records, else in-tree records/ at the passed head via the same code path as today.
decisions.reason: Matches the accepted reading; keeps pre-cutover and scratch checkouts working; gives 'same result as before'.

rejected.why: Breaks repositories before cutover and cannot distinguish worktree from in-tree records in tests.
Callers passing explicit historical treeishes must keep their meaning; changing existing tests is out of scope.

decisions.choice: One shared helper in athena-data::paths derives the common dir via git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir; backtest.rs and walltime.rs use it.
decisions.reason: Root cause is each reader deriving the git dir itself; fix it once for all readers.

rejected.why: Other readers keep the latent fault.

decisions.choice: Scoring and forecasting closures use the worktree when present regardless of the passed head; document in docs/decisions.md and test with a head differing from the worktree tip.
decisions.reason: After cutover the branch tip is the only complete history. Criterion 6 requires documenting and testing.

rejected.why: Would score against frozen main records.

decisions.choice: Put records_reader_scan in xtask/src/main.rs test module with an allow-list keyed by file plus function.
decisions.reason: xtask/tests is not a deliverable; call-site entries narrow the exception; a planted read proves failure.

rejected.why: Hides new reads in an allowed file.

decisions.reason: Out of scope per the brief.

steps: Grep Records::load, RecordSet::load, read_records, read_jobs, join("records over crates and xtask; keep the list for the change description.
Add paths.rs helpers with unit tests.
Add RecordSet::load_current and Records::load_current with fallback to the passed head.
Switch production callers and thread the state dir where needed; leave site.rs alone.
Switch introspect::read_records, backtest.rs and walltime.rs to the selected root and git's common dir.
Add records_reader_scan to xtask with call-site allow-list and tests including a planted read.
Write records_branch_readers.rs: worktree_ and fallback_ per reader, scratch_checkout, linked_worktree, scoring_ignores_passed_head; all state under tempdirs.
Add decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md entries citing D111.
Run fmt, clippy, cargo test --locked; confirm git diff omits xtask/src/site.rs; write the change description with the reader-to-test map and commands run.

risks.risk: Switching many callers breaks existing tests with explicit historical treeishes.
risks.mitigation: Switch only 'current' callers; fallback is identical without a worktree; run full cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Tests write to the real state root.
risks.mitigation: Every test sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir under a shared lock or child processes and asserts the path.

risks.risk: Producer snapshot lacks git history so worktree fixtures could fail.
risks.mitigation: Tests init their own repos in a tempdir.

risks.risk: Scan allow-list too broad or narrow.
risks.mitigation: Key by file and function; planted-read test and clean-tree test.

demonstrations.method: Integration test per reader: tempdir git repo with in-tree records/ holding record A, records worktree under a tempdir ATHENA_STATE_DIR holding record B; call the reader and assert B.
demonstrations.observes: All worktree_* tests pass, one per listed reader, each asserting B and not A.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader still reading in-tree records/ or HEAD returns A and its worktree_ test fails.

demonstrations.method: Same readers with no worktree; assert the result equals the old-path result (Records::load at head, read_records(root)).
demonstrations.observes: All fallback_* tests pass with results equal to the old path.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader that errors or returns empty without a worktree fails its fallback_ test.

demonstrations.method: Run the athena binary (CARGO_BIN_EXE_athena) status and the offline forecasting path on a scratch checkout with no records/ and a worktree holding them; compare output with a checkout that has records/.
demonstrations.observes: Both commands exit 0 and output equals the records/ run.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader needing working-tree records/ fails or prints empty history on the scratch checkout.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the change description for the grep command and the reader-to-test table; compare to the listed test names.
demonstrations.observes: Every test name in the description appears in the list and every grep hit is mapped or explained.

demonstrations.method: Test makes a repo, adds a linked worktree with git worktree add, sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir, creates the records worktree, and calls backtest and walltime readers from the linked checkout.
demonstrations.observes: The cli and xtask linked_worktree tests pass, finding worktree records.
demonstrations.fails_without: Deriving the git dir as <root>/.git fails from a linked checkout, where .git is a file, so the tests fail.

demonstrations.method: Every test sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir and asserts the worktree path is under it; a test passes a head differing from the worktree tip to scoring and forecast closures and asserts worktree results; read docs/decisions.md entry.
demonstrations.observes: Test passes and nothing is created under the real state root.
demonstrations.fails_without: A closure honouring the passed head returns main's records and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Scan test plants a records/ read in a non-allowed fixture file and asserts it is reported; another asserts the real tree is clean with function-level allow entries.
demonstrations.observes: Output shows 'test result: ok. N passed' with N at least 2.
demonstrations.fails_without: A scan ignoring planted reads fails the planted-read test; zero tests run would show N=0.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks, then git diff --stat to confirm site.rs is absent. The full test run includes the new worktree/fallback tests, so a missing reader move, a broken existing test or a formatting/lint regression fails it.
demonstrations.observes: cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked all exit 0; git diff --stat lists no xtask/src/site.rs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the behavior, a reader move that breaks an existing test fails cargo test --locked, an unformatted or lint-violating change fails fmt or clippy, and an edit to site.rs shows in git diff --stat.

demonstrations.method: Read the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry in the diff.
demonstrations.observes: Entry names the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list, site generator out of scope, and D111.
